references.title: Beloved Review, its back and better than ever. | Destiny 2
references.reviewEvidence: The main implementation session reported actually viewing this segment from the existing private download. This sidecar did not independently view the video.
observations: The rifle pitches and rolls up toward the left.
The magazine is pulled downward and replaced.

limitations: Beloved only. Historical gameplay provides qualitative motion reference, not current-sandbox timing certification. The 23.3-25.3 second window locates reviewed footage and is not an exact reload-duration measurement. The 21 normalized stages are authored approximations, not extracted video frames. No hand model, hand IK, bolt simulation, third-person reload animation, or reload claim for other weapons. Private source download excluded from repository and resource pack.
